builds.name: Twofold Hex: outbound and missing-health return
builds.summary: Investigate high one Twofold Hex initial and return sequence output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Twofold Hex initial and return sequence output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Initial Q is 45/70/95/120/145 + 0.4 AP magic. Return reaches up to 1.5 times that base with target missing health, while damage beyond the first hit can fall to 20%. The rank-5 nominal upper two-part helper is 362.5 + 1.0 AP only if the live return multiplier actually reaches its cap and both hits qualify.

kitEvidence.formula:
Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing [45 / 70 / 95 / 120 / 145 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to enemies and cursing them for [3.5] seconds.

Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to [(45 / 70 / 95 / 120 / 145 + (0.4) × AP) × (1.5)] magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%.

If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability.
